1.consolidated_definition: Planta trepadora con hojas pecioladas, inflorescencia en racimos, flores pequeñas de color azul y vainas alargadas. (Fabaceae; Calopogonium caeruleum).
1.en_consolidated_definition: Climbing plant with leafy petioles, racemose inflorescence, small blue flowers and elongated pods (Fabaceae; Calopogonium caeruleum).
